scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:worker && npm run typecheck:pages
scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build:frontend && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.local.jsonc && wrangler pages deploy --cwd pages --project-name movie-hell --branch master
scripts.validate: npm run privacy:scan && npm run typecheck && npm run worker:types:check && npm run build:frontend && npm run worker:dry-run && npm run audit
